scripts.start: cross-env WEB_PORT=3008 yarn run -T rspack serve --config-loader jiti
scripts.build: yarn clean && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=8192" NODE_ENV=production yarn run -T rspack build --config-loader jiti && node ./scripts/check-browser-compat.js && node ./scripts/finalize-production-assets.js && bash ./postbuild.sh
scripts.build:lavamoat: yarn clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=production ONEKEY_LAVAMOAT=1 ONEKEY_LAVAMOAT_GENERATE_POLICY=0 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 yarn run -T webpack build -c webpack.config.lavamoat.js && node scripts/check-browser-compat.js --lavamoat && node scripts/finalize-production-assets.js --strip-only && bash ./postbuild.sh
scripts.lavamoat:policy: cross-env NODE_ENV=production ONEKEY_LAVAMOAT=1 ONEKEY_LAVAMOAT_GENERATE_POLICY=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 yarn run -T webpack build -c webpack.config.lavamoat.js
